player_0.content: New plan: I entered the Closet twice (once via west from Sauna, and once via south from the initial Lobby path implied by the loop) but failed to recognize that I had already visited it, causing me to stop prematurely in the Sauna while unvisited rooms remained. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. When I encounter a room I have already been to, I will immediately switch to an untried direction instead of stopping.
